results.pinDescription: Blasts your enemy with lightning, dealing 1180 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Each jump reduces that victim's Nature resistance by 98. news.name: How to Complete Your Thunderfury in Phase 3 - WoW Classic Fresh
news.pinDescription: Phase 3 of the 20th Anniversary Servers introduces the final steps players will need to take to obtain their [item=19019]!

news.name: How to Acquire Thunderfury in Season of Discovery Phase 5
news.pinDescription: Season of Discovery Phase 5 has opened the doors to [url guide=26980]Blackwing Lair[/url], and now players will finally be able to get their hands on [item=230224]!

news.name: Possible Thunderfury-Themed Cloak on Season of Discovery PTR
news.pinDescription: There might be a fun bonus Thunderfury-themed item in store for players in Season of Discovery based on the Patch 1.15.4 PTR!

news.name: Thunderfury Model Size Adjusted on Classic Realms
news.pinDescription: With the launch of Season of Discovery Patch 1.15.3, eagle-eyed players have noticed a change to Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker - it's gotten significantly smaller.

news.name: Thunderfury Will Not Be Changing in Season of Discovery Phase 4
news.pinDescription: As we prepare for Phase 4 Season of Discovery, it has felt like every item has had some huge changes. So some players were relieved too learn that [item=19019] will not be changed.

news.name: July 2024 Trading Post Items - Diving Suit, Thunderfury Bow, Terrarium Backpiece
news.pinDescription: Blizzard has announced the July 2024 Trading Post which includes new mounts, a Diving Suit transmog and more!

news.name: Did Somebody Say Thunderfury, Blessed Bow of the Windseeker?!
news.pinDescription: Two new cosmetic bows featuring a very familiar design have been discovered on the Dragonflight Patch 10.2.5 PTR! The blue lightning Blessed Bow of the Windseeker and its alternate red-hued Titan Thunderbow may remind you of a certain legendary weapon...

news.name: WoW Classic Not A Bug List - Thunderfury Can be Equipped by All Sword Classes
news.pinDescription: Blizzard has updated their "not a bug" list for WoW Classic with a clarification concerning the legendary sword [item=19019].

news.name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker Available with WoW Classic Blackwing Lair Phase 3
news.pinDescription: Did someone say [item=19019]? While players have been able to collect the bindings since WoW Classic launch, [item=19019] will finally be obtainable in Phase 3 of WoW Classic when Blackwing Lair opens.

news.name: More NA and EU Classic Realms - Thunderfury, Benediction, Windseeker
news.pinDescription: Did someone say [item=19019]? Well you'll be right at home on the new servers Thunderfury and Windseeker. Six more Classic realms have been added this afternoon.

news.name: Classic WoW Phase Loot Clarifications and Confusion - Thunderfury Bindings Available at Launch
news.pinDescription: Blizzard has been clarifying how some phase loot works in Classic WoW. While some parts remain unclear, as to preserve an element of exploration, other parts have received more clarifications. For example, Thunderfury Bindings will be available at launch.

news.name: Shaman Order Hall Quest to Restore Thunderfury, Cataclysm Timewalking, Black Rook Hold Preview, Toy Box Spotlight
news.pinDescription:
Today's Legion video covers restoring Thunderfury for Shaman! We also have a Black Rook Hold dungeon guide by Method, information on Cataclysm Timewalking starting today, and Blizzard's Toy Box preview.[pad]
[center][youtube=47-dhuCzBB8][/center]

news.name: WoW's 11th Anniversary (November 16 - 30): Inflatable Thunderfury and VanCleef Costume
news.pinDescription:
[screenshot id=489698 width=200 size=resized float=right][/screenshot][event=566] runs from November 16 - 30th with new festive gifts! Log in to open [item=128513] in the mail, which contains the following:

[ul][li][item=128507] which rewards the [achievement=10335] Feat of Strength when used. Put [item=19019] in your off-hand to look like you're dual-wielding them. [b]This was hotfixed to no longer be BoA.[/b][/li]
[li]Bind-on-Account [item=128506] and [item=128505] wand disguises with 5 charges each.[/li]
[li][item=128510]: disguise with 50 charges, not tied to Hallow's End as predicted.[/li]

[li][item=127987] gives an 11% experience/reputation boost--great for [achievement=10018].[/li] [/ul]

WoW's 11th Anniversary runs from November 16th through November 30th. Logging in also awards the [achievement=10058] achievement. While not as elaborate as the [url=http://www.wowhead.com/guide=2750/wows-10th-anniversary-november-21-january-13]10th anniversary opening up Molten Core and Tarren Mill vs Southshore[/url], these are some unexpected perks.

Make sure to also check out our [b][url=http://www.wowhead.com/news=249943/patch-6-2-3-survival-guide]Patch 6.2.3 Survival Guide[/url][/b]--the patch goes live November 17th.

news.name: 6.2.2 PTR: Build 20395 New Mounts, Pets, Toys, Thunderfury, Hallow's End, and Winter Veil Items
news.pinDescription:
[db=ptr][img news=7988 width=300 float=right]A new PTR build is here, and we've moved on from 6.2.1 to 6.2.2! This features new Hallow's End and Winter Veil festivities, mounts, pets, toys, and...[achievement=10335]  [item=128507]?

[quote][b][url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/search?q=date%3A2015-08-12&refresh]Check out the latest database additions, including items![/url][/b][/quote]

[h2]New Mounts[/h2]

[ul][li][item=87776], added years ago in Mists of Pandaria's data, is the reward for getting 300 mounts ([url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/achievement=10355/lord-of-the-reins?refresh]Lord of the Reins[/url]). See which WoD mounts you're missing with the [url=http://www.wowhead.com/guides/vanity-collections/warlords-of-draenor-mount-collectors-guide]Warlords of Draenor Mount Guide[/url]![/li]
[li]The Legion's Collector's Edition will have a mount -- [b][item=128425]/[achievement=10320][/b].[/li]
[li]Other new mounts include the [item=128671] from Feast of Winter Veil, the [item=128422] as the latest Shop Mount, and the [item=129923] and [item=129922] from Timewalking.[/li][/ul]

[center][model npc=43697 img=http://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/blog/images/7986.png][/model] [model npc=64960 img=http://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/blog/images/7992.png][/model]
[model npc=27525 img=http://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/blog/images/7990.png][/model] [model npc=48946 img=http://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/blog/images/7991.png][/model][/center]

[h2]New Pets[/h2]
[ul][li][b][item=128427]/[achievement=10322][/b] is the pet reward from 2015 BlizzCon. He has cute abilities like [petability=1535].[/li]
[li][b][item=128423]/[achievement=10309][/b] is the pet from the Legacy of the Void Collector's Edition.[/li]
[li][b][npc=95841]/[achievement=10321][/b] is the pet from the Legion Collector's Edition.[/li]
[li][b][item=128424][/b] is a new pet from the in-game shop.[/li]
[li]New Hallow's End pets [npc=97568], [npc=97569], [npc=97324][/li]
[li]New Feast of Winter Veil pet [npc=97229].[/li][/ul]

Carry your pet on a sled with [item=128776]!

[h2]Pepe[/h2]
In [achievement=10365], Pepe now has a scarecrow form in [item=128874]! This achievement is related to Hallow's End.[pad]
[center][model object=28858 img=http://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/blog/images/7998.png][/model][model object=28858 img=http://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/blog/images/7996.png][/model]
[model object=28858 img=http://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/blog/images/7995.png][/model][model object=28858 img=http://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/blog/images/7997.png][/model][/center]

[h2]New Toys[/h2]
[ul][li][b][item=108632][/b] is the 2015 Winter Veil Toy.[/li]
[li]There is a related achievement to collect 5 toys in the "Iron Armada" set.[/li]
[li]The Iron Armada set involves looting [item=108632] and [item=108635] as part of Winter Veil, and [item=108631], [item=108633], and [item=108634] from rares in the eastern area of Tanaan Jungle.[/li]
[li]Collecting 200 toys rewards you with [achievement=10354] and [title=85].[/li]
[li]Toys most likely from Timewalking rewards: [item=129952], [item=129938], [item=129926][/li][/ul]

[item=127709] and [item=122117] are now classified as toys.

[h2]Build Highlights[/h2]
[ul][li][currency=1166] new currency to buy new toys, new mounts, and gear that scales up to the character's level at the time of purchase.[/li]
[li]Did someone say....[item=128507]?[/li]
[li]Lots of new [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/items?filter=minle=640;maxle=640;qu=2;cr=166;crs=6;crv=0#0-3]640 greens[/url]--perhaps they're the lvl 100 boosted gear.[/li]
[li]Strings have been added for the Level 100 Boost coming in Legion. Just getting back to WoW now? Check out our tips for [url=http://www.wowhead.com/guides/new-level-90-player-basics-and-tips]boosted 90[/url] and [url=http://www.wowhead.com/guides/new-level-100-player-basics-and-tips]fresh 100 players[/url].[/li]
[li]New Timewalking rewards, including [url=http://ptr.wowhead.com/items=12?filter=qu=7;cr=166;crs=6;crv=0]reputation tokens for Burning Crusade and Wrath dungeons[/url].[/li]
[li]New legendary catch-up quests [quest=40235].[/li][/ul]
